title: Multi-modal Data Spectrum: Multi-modal Datasets are Multi-dimensional

bias_targets.methodology: Modality shuffling/permutation technique, where one input modality (e.g., the image or the text) is replaced with a randomly sampled instance from another data point. The resulting performance degradation is measured to quantify the model's reliance on a single modality (intra-modality dependency) versus multi-modal reasoning.
